The bird has dark, iridescent plumage on its head and neck, transitioning to mottled brown feathers on its body and wings. One wing is raised high in a display or stretching motion. It features prominent red eyebrow combs above the eyes and visible white undertail coverts. The legs appear feathered down to the feet.
